purpose: Evaluation-only synthetic pilot for Friday task_update interpretation; not a training corpus or device action suite.
provenance: Original hand-authored English examples. No device state, private chats, contacts, credentials, messages or app observations were used.
split_policy: All cases are held-out evaluation. Do not train, distill, tune prompts, or select checkpoints on these cases; make a separate training set and a separate model-selection set. If these examples inform a change, report contamination and replace the evaluation set.

interface.text_from: JSON-serialize input exactly; input.fields is the complete model-field set for the capability.
interface.normalization: Dates YYYY-MM-DD using input.date; start/end HH:mm; duration positive whole minutes as a string; title/query/zone equal the copied span trimmed. update requires at least one update; new and clarify require an empty updates array.
interface.authority: Destination packages, create authorization, all-day/overnight flags, cancellation, external effects and verification belong to the native coordinator. No output may introduce those fields. An accepted patch is not task completion.

evaluation.patch_scoring: Compare operation and the set of field/text/value triples; update order is immaterial. Required spans in this pilot are unique. Score protocol validation and semantic expected-output agreement separately.
evaluation.context_scoring: expected_partial_context.fields contains supplied/accepted facts after a semantic update; it is not a full serialized TaskInputContext and does not grant action authority. missing lists unresolved data only. For new, fields describes the old draft, which this patch must leave unmodified; it does not describe the new task.
evaluation.path_scoring: production_path is a read-time prediction from TaskIntake and CalendarRequest, not measured invocation evidence. native_fast_path, native_blocked and fresh_native_routing cases usually bypass Writer. slm_fallback_candidate assumes a pending same-chat draft, no earlier uncertain external dispatch, and no competing app-search route.
evaluation.native_guard_cases: TU11, TU12 and TU16 have semantically safe clarify outputs which the current CalendarRequest.capture guard rejects even when updates is empty. Keep them as native-routing/semantic negatives and report this validator rejection separately; do not count it as an SLM decoding failure.
evaluation.limits: No GPU/phone/model execution is represented. Exact-span and typed-value checks cannot establish the truth of a model-normalized relative date or duration when the native parser has no equivalent. Review those interpretations independently. This pilot does not measure drafting, multilingual use, UI navigation, messages, bills, research or booking.
